Boat 7 abandoned the submerged truck to save their own crew. The packing plant is out of county and an hour away. Ellen is in the county and at the point of peak river rise at the dam.

I am trading the potential for mass casualties at the packing plant for the immediate certainty of a rescue for Ellen, who is in the path of the peak. Sending Boat 4 to the packing plant now would mean Ellen is left with no hope of rescue as the river peaks.
